content.short: OpenTrade is an institutional-grade RWA platform bringing US Treasury yields and private credit on-chain.
content.description: OpenTrade is a leading decentralized finance protocol designed to bridge the gap between traditional financial markets and the digital economy by tokenizing real-world assets. Built on the Perimeter Protocol, the platform allows participants to earn secure yields from institutional-grade assets such as US Treasuries and commercial paper. Through its "Yield-as-a-Service" model, OpenTrade provides a transparent and non-custodial framework for liquidity. By utilizing the ERC-4626 vault standard, the protocol ensures maximum composability and professional-grade compliance for users.
content.meta: OpenTrade provides tokenized US Treasuries and institutional-grade private credit yields. Find OpenTrade and more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
